title: Keep every chip amount a safe integer
description: Follow-up from TASK-1.21 (doc-29) judge J-1-01 and code review. The A-4 bound assumes a 4-bet cap that the engine does not enforce yet (TASK-1.12), and stacks up to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER are accepted. The judge played a legal 10-seat hand at the A-4 bound that produced 11 unsafe numbers (largest 90071992547408820). minimumStack's doc comment also claims the cap. No test pins the factor 10 in A-4 or that createHand reads each field once.

nodes.title: Keep every chip amount a safe integer
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Rank showdown hands by real poker hand rankings
Deal every hand from a seeded shuffle with a replay code
Play a complete fixed-limit hand from blinds to showdown
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request
Harden engine input validation found in review

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given any config createHand accepts, When the hand is played legally to the end, Then every stack, contribution, pot and award stays a safe integer (stacks bounded in createHand, or proven via the TASK-1.12 cap), and a test plays the worst case
Given stakes with bigBet 2^49 and stacks 2^52, When createHand validates them, Then it rejects them with 'Invalid stakes' (pins the factor 10 in the A-4 bound)
Given a config built from one-shot getters or a counting Proxy, When createHand runs, Then each field is read exactly once (test)
Given minimumStack's doc comment, When read, Then it does not claim a cap the engine doesn't enforce
